plugins.name: Hotel Guest System (JSON, token auth)
plugins.description: Demo hotel guest system over JSON with a username/password token login. Matches room number + guest name; stay window from checkIn/checkOut.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: examples/guest-api demo server (edit the URL to your host)

plugins.name: Hotel Guest System (XML, API key)
plugins.description: Same demo guest system, XML response with an X-Api-Key header. Shows the XML parser and attribute/element paths.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: examples/guest-api demo server (edit the URL to your host)

plugins.name: Hotel Guest System (plain text, API key)
plugins.description: Same demo guest system, plain-text response parsed with a named-group regex (one record per line).
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: examples/guest-api demo server (edit the URL to your host)

plugins.name: RMS Cloud — surname + room
plugins.description: RMS Hospitality Cloud (rmscloud.com) via its REST API. Logs in with agent + client credentials, searches reservations by room and surname, and windows on arrival/departure.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: RMS Cloud API access: agent ID + agent password (from RMS), and a client ID + "Web Service password" (from the property). See docs/plugins/rms-cloud.md.

plugins.name: RMS Cloud — room + any guest detail
plugins.description: RMS Hospitality Cloud, room number plus any one of last name / first name / email / mobile. Two-step lookup: searches reservations by room, then fetches each guest record to fill in contact details.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: RMS Cloud API access: agent ID + agent password (from RMS), and a client ID + "Web Service password" (from the property). See docs/plugins/rms-cloud.md.

plugins.name: Mews Connector API
plugins.description: Mews (mews.com) via its Connector API. Every request carries a client + access token pair (no separate login step); a multi-step lookup finds the resource by room, then current reservations, then each guest's contact details.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: Mews Connector API access: a Client token (from Mews) and an Access token (from the property). See docs/plugins/mews.md.

plugins.name: Apaleo
plugins.description: Apaleo (apaleo.com) via its Booking API. OAuth2 client-credentials login with HTTP Basic auth, then a single reservations search filtered by property, status and stay dates.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: An Apaleo developer account with a client ID + client secret, and the property code. See docs/plugins/apaleo.md.

plugins.name: Cloudbeds
plugins.description: Cloudbeds (cloudbeds.com) via its REST API. A static API key on every request, filtered to checked-in reservations for a room; matches any guest sharing that room, not just the primary guest.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: A Cloudbeds API key and property ID (Cloudbeds partner/developer sandbox, or a live property with API access enabled). See docs/plugins/cloudbeds.md.

plugins.name: CSV / Google Sheet guest list
plugins.description: Any CSV over HTTP — a Google Sheet published to web as CSV, or any URL serving text/csv. No login system required; ideal for a spreadsheet a front desk already keeps.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: A CSV URL reachable without login (a Google Sheet published to web works). See docs/plugins/csv-and-guest-list.md.

plugins.name: Eventbrite attendees
plugins.description: Eventbrite (eventbrite.com) via its v3 API. Checks an attendee's email + last name against one event's attendee list, paginating through every page; the event's own start/end time bounds the Wi-Fi window.
plugins.author: Tikspot
plugins.requires: An Eventbrite private token and the numeric event ID. See docs/plugins/eventbrite.md.
